name: automations
description: Agent work that starts itself: run a prompt through the app's AI, create an Agent Tasks task or start a worker on a daily, interval or cron schedule, or when an Agent Tasks task completes, fails, blocks, opens a gate or loses its worker. Runs on the server, with no browser open.

automations.missedRunGraceMinutes.description: When the server starts after being down, a scheduled run it missed fires once if it was due within this many minutes. Older missed runs are skipped and rescheduled. 0 fires nothing missed.

automations.aiProfile.description: Which AI answers headless automations. Empty uses the default in Settings - AI Providers.
